claims.claim: President Donald Trump will attend a December 4 groundbreaking for an expansion of TSMC's Phoenix plant.

claims.source_title: Trump to attend groundbreaking for TSMC Arizona plant expansion
claims.supporting_quote: President Donald Trump will attend a groundbreaking ceremony on the 4th of next month for an expansion of Taiwanese chipmaker TSMC's semiconductor plant in Phoenix, Arizona.

claims.claim: A company spokesperson confirmed President Trump will attend the December 4 TSMC ceremony.
claims.episode_span: a company spokesperson confirmed
claims.source_title: President Trump to visit Phoenix for TSMC groundbreaking
claims.supporting_quote: The ceremony will take place on Dec. 4 for a new TSMC chipmaking plant, a spokesperson from the company confirmed to 12News that President Donald Trump will attend.

claims.source_title: Trump to attend groundbreaking for TSMC Arizona plant expansion
claims.supporting_quote: The White House official said the expansion is expected to create more than 10,000 direct jobs once completed. Between 12,000 and 15,000 construction and support workers are currently working at the site.
